# Which of your Etsy ads lose money?

> Free Etsy Ads ROI analyzer: drop in your Shop Manager ad report and see which listings lose money after ad spend and what share of sales the ad must cause to break even. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/etsy-ads-roi-analyzer/)
